inclusion_rule: Text-producing speech decoders from non-acoustic or neural signals (surface EMG, EEG, MEG, ECoG, intracortical, ultrasound, articulography, lip video, fMRI) whose ledger mentions a use-time language model, lexicon, beam search or rescoring. The design compared is the use-time language prior: an n-gram or lexicon-constrained beam search, neural language-model rescoring, or a large language model that rescores or rewrites the decoded transcript. Boundary: language models used only to build training targets or stimuli do not count; acoustic-only ASR is excluded; versions of one study count once.
